title: Manufactured Home Decor Piece Made From Real Rose Petals
text:
Manufactured Home Decor Piece Made From Real Rose Petals. This CAVEBEAR 01 24K GOLD LONG STEM ROSE (Real, Fresh, Dipped, Plated; Red) is advertised misleadingly as a “real fresh” rose, or as a “gold-plated” rose. What it is, is a manufactured home decor piece. Fresh roses are taken apart, their petals (and stems, I think) are coated in plastic and edged in gold, and then the encased plastic pieces are reassembled into a product that more or less looks like a rose.

I don’t care for this “forever” rose at all. Although you can see the veins of the original rose petals through the plastic, the piece is very heavy, and looks more artificial than a plastic rose. As a gift, I would far rather receive a single fresh rose than one of these “dipped, fresh, gold-plated” roses.

Before you buy, you should consider where you might want to display this rose. It’s a decorative piece that is an awkward height, and that is easily knocked over. (The plastic stand adds even more height.) Also, you should shop around for the best Amazon price. Gold-plated roses with opened flowers like this one seem to cost a little less than the ones with tightly closed buds.
